priority_1.workout_details: 45-minute steady-state flat run. 10-minute progressive warm-up. 30 minutes continuous running strictly in Zone 2. 5-minute walk cool-down. Focus on maintaining a fast, light cadence (85-90 rpm) and a tall posture.
priority_1.reason: This is your highest priority. It builds necessary 5km running volume which has been lacking in your recent block, while keeping metabolic stress low enough to facilitate recovery from your -17.1 TSB fatigue state.

priority_2.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 mins mobility. Barbell Back Squats: 3 sets x 5 reps at 75% 1RM. Barbell Overhead Press: 3 sets x 5 reps. Kettlebell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlifts: 3 sets x 8 reps per side (20kg KB). Heavy Sandbag Carry: 3 sets x 50 meters (70kg bag). Core: 3 sets of 15 hanging knee raises.
priority_2.reason: An excellent alternative if you want to avoid joint impact. It builds the raw torque necessary for your 5-minute cycling goals and running economy, without taxing your cardiovascular system on a high-fatigue day.

priority_3.workout_details: 15-minute warm-up including 3x 30-sec fast-cadence spin-ups. Main Set: 2 blocks of 10x (30 seconds at 290W / 30 seconds easy recovery spin). Take 5 minutes of light spinning recovery between blocks. 10-minute warm-down.
priority_3.reason: This high-challenge session directly targets your 5-minute VO2max power goal. However, it is ranked third and is ONLY recommended if you feel subjectively phenomenal, as your training metrics suggest you are carrying too much fatigue to hit these numbers optimally.
